meta.name: content-decay-detector
meta.description: Monitor existing content for ranking drops and trigger refresh workflows. Triggers on: "check for content decay", "which content needs updating", "content refresh", "ranking drops", "traffic decline", "stale content", "content audit", "what to refresh", "outdated content", "content performance check", "update old articles", "declining rankings", "content maintenance", "refresh priority list", "which articles are losing traffic", "SEO content audit".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测内容排名下降并提醒更新
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理大量博客文章并希望保持搜索排名稳定
copy.tagline_en: Detect ranking drops and trigger content refresh
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage many blog posts and want to keep search rankings stable

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能检查博客文章排名是否下降，识别过时内容，并生成一份优先刷新的文章列表和具体操作建议。
howto.when: 当你说出“检查内容衰减”、“哪些内容需要更新”、“内容刷新”等关键词，或要求执行SEO内容审计时触发。

say.text: 检查我的博客内容衰减情况。
say.note: Claude会自动发现索引页面，并生成衰减报告。
列出需要刷新的文章及优先级。

say.text: 给我一份内容刷新优先级列表。
say.note: 会给出P0到P3的排序和具体操作。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can monitor blog content for ranking drops, identify outdated articles, and generate a prioritized refresh queue with specific actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "check for content decay", "which content needs updating", "content refresh", or similar phrases, or when performing an SEO content audit.

say_en.text: Check my blog for content decay.
say_en.note: Claude discovers indexed pages and generates a decay report.

say_en.text: Which of my articles need updating?
say_en.note: Lists articles needing refresh with priorities.

say_en.text: Give me a refresh priority list.
say_en.note: Outputs a P0-P3 sorted queue with actions.
